request.style: English, warm folk, bright honest female vocal, acoustic guitar, banjo, upright bass, light percussion, homely and tender, 92 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Teacher came to Bethany and Martha opened wide
Her door, her bread, her table, and the fire burned inside
Her sister sat at the Lord's feet and listened to his word
While Martha served alone and felt that no one saw or heard
Lord, don't you care that my sister has left me to serve alone
Tell her to help me

[Chorus]
Martha, Martha, anxious over many things
Few things are needed, only one
The good portion at his feet
Will not be taken away

[Verse]
Then sorrow came to Bethany, her brother in the grave
Four days in the tomb and nothing left to save
She ran to meet him on the road before the others came
Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died
Jesus said to her, I am the resurrection and the life

[Bridge]
Do you believe this
Yes, Lord
I believe that you are the Christ, the Son of God
The one coming into the world

[Chorus]
Martha, Martha, anxious over many things
Few things are needed, only one
The good portion at his feet
Will not be taken away

[Outro]
Few things are needed, only one
Will not be taken away
